deps.edn.reason: The git floors on error, bytes, test and text point at repositories that are bundled here as kotoba.error, kotoba.bytes, kotoba.test and kotoba.text; they become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. :paths and :aliases are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the source and test paths.
